attchmntText: Mangalam Organics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Vaibhav Gandhi as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mangalam Organics Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. Vaibhav Gandhi, DIN 09560852, as an Additional Independent Director for a term from November 14, 2026, to November 13, 2031. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. The cut-off date for voting eligibility is November 13, 2026. E-voting is scheduled to commence on November 17, 2026, and conclude on December 16, 2026. Scrutinizer results are awaited.

attchmntText: The Board at its meeting held today, November 14, 2026 considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Statements of the Company for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, as reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee, together with the Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.
voiceSummary: Mangalam Organics Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also appointed Mr. Vaibhav Gandhi, with DIN 09560852, as an Additional Independent Director for a term of five years from November 14, 2026, to November 13, 2031. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval via a special resolution through postal ballot. The cut-off date for determining member eligibility is November 13, 2026. The postal ballot notice will be submitted to stock exchanges and published on the company website. Voting is scheduled to commence on November 17, 2026, and conclude on December 16, 2026. Scrutinizer results are awaited.
